expedition_event_void_scan_desc: Deep-space arrays swept the sector in silence. No exploitable signatures remained on the scope.
expedition_event_mineral_deposit_desc: Surface probes locked onto a shallow ore vein. Extraction teams marked the vein for rapid harvest before the window closed.
expedition_event_fuel_cache_desc: A drifting refueling pod surfaced on long-range scan. Its cells still held usable charge after decades adrift.
expedition_event_debris_salvage_desc: Hull fragments spun through the void in a slow arc. The fleet sorted the wreckage and recovered usable scrap metal.
expedition_event_nav_interference_desc: Ionized storm fronts scrambled the navigation matrix. The fleet had to compute a longer return vector through unstable space.
expedition_event_distress_beacon_desc: A fractured distress pulse cut through the static. Following the signal, the fleet found a drifting supply pod venting heat into the void.
expedition_event_sensor_glitch_desc: Anomalous readings bloomed on every screen, then collapsed on approach. Instrument noise — nothing more.
expedition_event_ancient_stash_desc: A sealed precursor cache resisted every scan until the fleet cracked its lock. Unknown technology, unknown origin — but the contents were real.

desc_metal_mine: Extracts Ferronit from your planet’s crust. Higher levels significantly increase production output.
desc_crystal_mine: Harvests valuable Crytite from deep veins. Essential for high-tech modules and research.
desc_solar_plant: Large collector arrays that convert starlight into Aetherion energy to power your colony.
desc_research_lab: The core of your scientific progress. Higher levels speed up research and unlock new technologies.
desc_academy: Speeds up all research times by 5% per Academy level. Requires Research Lab level 2.
desc_metal_storage: Expands storage capacity for Ferronit and prevents production stops caused by full depots.
desc_crystal_storage: Specialized silos for Crytite. Crucial for financing large high-tech projects.
desc_command_center: Unlocks military and late-game buildings. Reduces Nano-Assembly build time by 25% per level.
desc_orbital_shipyard: Unlocks ship construction. Higher levels unlock better hull classes and reduce ship build times by 10% per level.
desc_shipyard: Unlocks ship construction. Higher levels unlock better hull classes.

defense_no_buildable: Build a Defense Factory first or upgrade its level.
defense_sentinel_turret_desc: Light planetary gun effective against scouts and light fighters.
defense_plasma_arc_desc: Medium energy cannon with strong penetration against couriers and interceptors.
defense_ion_bastion_desc: Heavy fortification against combat ships and haulers.
defense_flak_array_desc: Multi-launcher battery with rapid fire against small and medium targets.
defense_pulse_barrier_desc: Energy shield that absorbs incoming fire before hull damage.
defense_orbital_shield_desc: Powerful orbital shield generator protecting the entire colony.
desc_barracks: Training grounds for crews and marines. Foundation for a strong military presence and fleet crews.
desc_radar_array: High-resolution scan network that detects foreign fleets early and gives you tactical advantages in space.
desc_shield_generator: Creates multilayered energy shields that protect your colony from bombardments and first strike waves.
desc_terraformer: The Terraformer creates safe infrastructure zones — not extra building slots, but usable industrial and storage capacity. Increases Ferronit and Crytite storage by 5% per level. Stacks with storage buildings and Storage Technology.
desc_nanofactory: Reduces build times for all buildings by 30% per level. Stacks with Construction Optimization and Research Lab.
desc_geothermal_nexus: A deep geothermal control complex that taps mantle energy and unlocks higher maximum levels for mines, solar collectors and storage structures. A key endgame facility for planetary stability and economic scaling.
desc_planet_core_nexus: Endgame: +1 max level for Ferronit Mine, Crytite Extractor and Solar Collectors per level (base max 50).
desc_energy_tech: Optimizes conduits, converters and reactors. Reduces the energy consumption of your mines by 5% per level.
desc_mining_tech: +10% Ferronit production and +4% Crytite production per level. Stacks with Drone Optimization.
desc_buildtime_tech: Standardized modules and automated site logistics significantly reduce build and research times.
desc_storage_tech: Increases Ferronit and Crytite storage capacity by 25% per level. Stacks with storage buildings and Terraformer.
desc_research_drones_tech: Improved mining and service drones maximize uptime and precision. Adds an extra production bonus per level.
desc_research_navigation_tech: Refined jump vectors and pathing through hyperspace shorten flight times and make operations more predictable.
desc_research_engine_tech: High-performance drives with cryogenic cooling increase thrust for large fleets and reduce energy losses.
desc_research_weapon_tech: Advanced laser, projectile and energy weapons considerably increase your fleets’ firepower.
desc_research_armor_tech: Layered composite armor and adaptive material design enhance the survivability of your ships.
desc_research_shield_tech: Advanced shield generators, modulators and field amplifiers harden your defenses against concentrated fire.
desc_drone_tech: +3% Ferronit and Crytite production per level. Stacks with Metal Refinement.
desc_navigation_tech: Planned: +3% fleet speed per level (not yet live). Requires Research Lab 3 and Drone Optimization 2.
desc_engine_tech: Planned: +2% fleet speed and +2% cargo per level. Unlocks Nano-Assembly Complex among others.
desc_weapon_tech: Planned: +5% weapons bonus per level for combat. No resource bonus.
desc_armor_tech: Planned: +5% armor bonus per level. Requires Weapons Development level 1.
desc_shield_tech: Planned: +5% shield bonus per level. No planetary or fleet shield effect yet.
